visualStyleNotes: Data And Statistics, Math palette, Anatomy Atelier bar: warm off-white/paper background (#F7F3EC) with soft radial vignette, no floor grid, no props. A measuring board with a row of point cubes, one lifted out, and a chart plate behind. Soft neutral studio light, no rim-light glow, no bloom, no emissive. Strong saturated color reserved for the small flat hotspot dots (amber / molecular-green / grid-blue from the Math palette). Specimen-quality clean-3D, not cartoon, not cluttered.
materialNotes: Metallic-roughness PBR, metallic=0 everywhere. Point cubes: warm paper cubes with ink value tags (roughness ~0.5). Measuring board: warm paper panel with subtle ruler ticks. Chart plate: warm paper panel behind, with a faint dot grid. Mean line (demo): thin dashed warm-ink strip. Mat: soft warm-grey (roughness ~0.85). No emissive channels — highlights handled by app runtime UI.
assetBrief:
SUBJECT: the data point as one observation — a row of labeled cubes on a measuring board, each a child's height; lifting a cube shows its tag; dragging a cube to the chart plate turns it into a dot on a growing line graph.

GEOMETRY: A measuring board with a row of small cubes in ascending order, each with a label tag ('Ali', 'Mia', ...) and a value (cm). One cube can be lifted out to the front and read. 'Add measurement' slides a new cube in. Dragging a cube onto the chart plate behind places a dot at its height; multiple dots connect into a growing line graph. A 'mean' demo draws a dashed line at the average of the placed points.

LAYERS (toggleable): (1) measuring board; (2) dataset row; (3) point cubes + tags; (4) chart plate + dots.

CAMERA: three-quarter from front-left, slightly above, frames board and chart plate; labels legible. Budget 5-9k triangles. Named nodes: Board, DatasetRow, PointCubes, ValueTags, ChartPlate, Dots, MeanLine. All labels are hotspot dots in the app layer.
